input: Shop for a new winter coat on sale

gold.taskTitle: Shop for a New Winter Coat on Sale
gold.taskDescription: Find and purchase a discounted winter coat that meets the user's specific needs and preferences.

questions.title: What is your total budget for the coat?
questions.description: Understand the maximum amount the user is willing to spend, including any sale expectations.

questions.title: Do you prefer shopping online, in-store, or both?
questions.description: Determine the preferred shopping channel to focus the search appropriately.

questions.title: What style of coat are you looking for?
questions.description: Identify the coat style such as parka, peacoat, puffer, trench, or other.

questions.title: What is your gender and size for the coat?
questions.description: Gather sizing details to narrow down relevant options.

questions.title: How cold are the winters where you will wear it?
questions.description: Understand the climate and temperature range to determine the required warmth level.

questions.title: Do you have any preferred brands or ones to avoid?
questions.description: Identify brand preferences or restrictions to filter the coat search.

questions.title: Do you need the coat by a specific date?
questions.description: Establish any deadline that affects shipping options or urgency of the purchase.
